title: TCD-026 Fresh-Organic-Matter Initial Exudate Storage Ledger Independent Second-Line Review
result_scope: Independent second-line review evidence only. This record does not perform B3 admission.

atomic_claim.claim: The already-existing initial root-exudate organic-matter state Ex(Ln) contributes Ex(Ln)*P to Bfom(Inip_x,Ly).

independent_checks.name: exact_frozen_B0_source_and_testbank_identity
independent_checks.finding: The GitHub sidecars reproduce exactly the required source and testbank SHA-256 identities. PREP06 source reverification is bound to the same source archive and reports identity_match=true.

independent_checks.name: ex_physical_ownership_and_lifecycle
independent_checks.finding: Ex(:)->Rsex(:) is a PHYSICAL_STORAGE root-exudate organic-matter state in kg OM m-2. INITIAL orgexu supplies Ex; Root/Addit/Resp_miner mutate the physical state; Init commits Ex(Ln)=Rsex(Ln); restart output persists Rsex.

independent_checks.name: bfom_begin_storage_ownership
independent_checks.finding: Bfom(Inip_x,Ly) is the fresh-organic-matter beginning-storage ledger surface. The corresponding final storage Bfom(Finp_x,Ly) already includes Rsex(Ln)*Z. Organic-N and organic-P beginning ledgers already include Ex through Nifrex and Pofrex composition.

independent_checks.name: exact_omitted_term
independent_checks.finding: The hash-bound source audit directly parses Outbal_Init.for and Outbal_calc.for: initial Bfom has no Ex(Ln), final Bfom has Rsex(Ln), while Bano/Bapo beginning storage includes Ex. The atomic omitted fresh-OM beginning term is Ex(Ln)*P.

independent_checks.name: class_A_reporting_only_atomicity
independent_checks.finding: The correction is confined to an omitted beginning-storage ledger term for an already represented physical state. No state, process flux, initialization, restart or numerical-policy mutation is required, matching B3Q01 Class A.

independent_checks.name: prep06_synthetic_10_kg_ha_discriminator
independent_checks.finding: With only Ex(1)=1.0e-3 kg m-2, PREP06 introduces exactly 10.0 kg ha-1. Legacy fresh-OM residual is -10.0 kg ha-1; adding only Ex(Ln)*P removes the discriminator to floating-point roundoff. The small residual is not treated as a tolerance.

independent_checks.name: model_produced_cranmais_restart_activation
independent_checks.finding: A model-produced CranMais INITIAL.OUT supplies nonzero Ex in layers 1..9 totaling 5989.6594 kg ha-1. Legacy and candidate start from identical restart bytes; the candidate adds the matching beginning store and changes only four declared balance/report surfaces. Final restart output is byte-identical between candidate and legacy.

independent_checks.name: chronological_cranmais_1974_1975_formatted_restart_activation
independent_checks.finding: The 1974 model-produced INITIAL.OUT is fed byte-identically into the 1975 segment, activating 642.718929 kg ha-1 Ex over layers 1..9. Candidate-vs-legacy final restart state is byte-identical and only the four declared restart-case balance/report surfaces change.

independent_checks.name: candidate_vs_legacy_restart_state_identity_interpretation
independent_checks.finding: For identical formatted restart input, the candidate ledger observation does not change restart state: legacy and candidate final INITIAL.OUT hashes are identical. This establishes candidate non-interference only; it is not a claim that formatted restart is an exact representation of uninterrupted execution.

independent_checks.name: continuous_vs_formatted_restart_negative_scope_boundary
independent_checks.finding: Uninterrupted versus formatted-restart CranMais is not byte-identical: 32 of 564 compared numeric tokens differ, with maximum printed absolute difference 1.0e-6. This remains a negative scope boundary and is not promoted to a tolerance or whole-model identity claim.

independent_checks.name: expected_difference_whitelist_and_non_interference
independent_checks.finding: The global PREP06 discriminator changes exactly ani_omGP.Bal, ani_omRP.Bal, ani_omTP.Bal, baomGP.Out, baomRP.Out and baomTP.Out. The restart activations change the declared subset ani_omMP.Bal, ani_omTP.Bal, baomMP.Out and baomTP.Out. No unexpected scientific output changes were observed; physical state, process flux, restart state, forcing and unrelated ledgers remain outside the write set.

independent_checks.name: no_tcd026_specific_SYNQ01_oracle
independent_checks.finding: The full qualified SYNQ01 register contains 12 oracles and no TCD-026 target. No synthetic oracle is falsely claimed for TCD-026.

independent_checks.name: STATEQ02_support_boundary
independent_checks.finding: STATEQ02 is used only to support physical continuation-state ownership/restart relevance. It is not used as a TCD-026 ledger oracle, whole-model restart oracle, historical B2 reference or admission evidence.

independent_checks.name: same_context_B3A04R_not_counted_as_independent
independent_checks.finding: B3A04R identifies itself as TECHNICAL_REVIEW_SAME_AUTHORING_CONTEXT_NOT_INDEPENDENT_SECOND_LINE and independent_second_line_qualified=false. Its technical PASS is input evidence only.

independent_checks.name: GOV03_and_B3D07_live_validity
independent_checks.finding: Live branch checks place B3D07 exactly at 21766eaf3443bcf432f05fbf6ba89d365bc70988 and GOV03 exactly at cbd262bdabe92923113b7326f2f42822ce9a971c. GOV03 keeps B2 unavailable and opens only the claim-scoped historical-uncertainty route; B3D07 remains UNRESOLVED_NOT_ADMITTED with independent review blocking.

independent_checks.name: no_historical_fidelity_claim

independent_checks.name: no_composition_B4_production_patch_or_migration
independent_checks.finding: The reviewed atomic claim is not composed with other organic-matter TCDs. No B4 action, production source patch or production migration is performed or authorized by this review.

This GitHub-only review independently inspects the exact hash-bound source-audit implementation and persisted source-reverification result; it does not claim a new raw-byte parse in this chat.
No qualified B2 exists, so historical revision-53 executable behaviour and historical fidelity remain UNKNOWN.

Continuous CranMais execution and the formatted-restart path show small but real printed-state differences. Their cause is outside TCD-026 and no tolerance or whole-model checkpoint equivalence is inferred.
There is no TCD-026-specific SYNQ01 oracle; PREP06 and the two CranMais activations remain diagnostic causal/non-interference evidence, not B2.
